sentences.text:
Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
13.02.2024 Item No.8 Chc Rejected C.R.M.(A) 413 of 2024 In Re:- An application for anticipatory
bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kaliganj Police Station
Case No. 855 of 2023 dated 01.12.2023 under Sections 498A/313/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
read with Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

And  In the matter of : Md Ashadul Sardar @ Ashadul Sardar ...... petitioner Mr. Ali Ahsan Alamgir,
Ms. Rabia Khatoon, Ms. Soma Mal, Ms. June Modak ....for the petitioner Mr. Apurba Kr. Datta ....for the State Petitioner prays for anticipatory bail.
Materials in the Case Diary suggest that, de facto complainant underwent abortion.

She implicates the petitioner before us, who is her husband,
with regard to the physical assault leading to such abortion.
De facto complainant also claims that, petitioner suppressed his earlier marriage with another lady and married the de facto complainant.
In view of the materials in the Case Diary and in view of the relationship between the petitioner and the de facto complainant, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
